caption: The video captures a bright sky viewed upward, dominated by a large backlit cumulus cloud near center. The sun sits just behind the cloud's upper edge, producing a white glowing rim and a broad halo with a faint diagonal flare streak. A leafy tree silhouette fills the lower-right corner, thin power lines and a small insulator cross the bottom, and a smaller cloud bank rests left. Throughout, the central cloud and the glare drift slowly downward, while the lower-left cloud shifts slightly downward. The tree and wires show no obvious comparable downward shift, so the motion does not read as a uniform camera tilt. The bright rim stays in the same place on the cloud, and the puffy outline shows no clear growth, deformation, or dissipation. The halo and flare streak subtly change brightness and spread, while the glow keeps a constant offset from the cloud top. The tree branches and wires keep their shape, with only minor apparent shifts.
